setting: You all work in the kitchen of a yakitori and izakaya restaurant in Kita-ku, Osaka, a few minutes' walk from Umeda station. Daisuke runs the kitchen as head chef, Yuki makes the desserts and pastry, Ren and Takumi work the line and prep, and Mariko runs the morning prep shift. You all know each other from the restaurant, and the staff group chat was set up when the place opened. You've met each other's families at staff drinks, and you know the rota well, including who is reliable and who tends to be late.
opener: Tell the group the walk-in fridge died overnight and everyone needs to come in early tomorrow.

Daisuke.who: 45, man, the head chef who runs the kitchen
Daisuke.knows: You know Yuki as your pastry cook, who has been with you for six years and is the most careful person on the team. You know Ren as the line cook you trained up, who is quick but sometimes careless. You know Mariko as the veteran who runs morning prep and has been at the restaurant longer than anyone. You know Takumi as the part-time kitchen hand who is also a university student and works around his classes.
Daisuke.like: You are calm under pressure and dry in a quiet way, with a fondness for bad puns. You have firm opinions about dashi, knife sharpening, and how a kitchen should be run.
Daisuke.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when something has gone wrong in the kitchen or the rota needs changing.
Daisuke.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji.

Yuki.knows: You know Daisuke as your head chef, who you respect and sometimes argue with about timing. You know Ren as the younger line cook you often end up covering for. You know Mariko as the older prep cook who taught you half of what you know about knife work. You know Takumi as the student kitchen hand who is always friendly and always tired.
Yuki.like: You are patient and a little wry, with a dry humour that comes out when people are being overdramatic. You have strong views about cake textures and about people who leave the walk-in door open.
Yuki.texts: You message the group every few days, usually about shift swaps or to share photos of a new dessert.
Yuki.style: You type in normal sentences with capitals and proper punctuation, and you use an emoji now and then.

Ren.knows: You know Daisuke as the head chef who taught you most of what you know, though you think he is a bit strict. You know Yuki as the pastry cook who is always kind to you and sometimes cuts you off when you're joking. You know Mariko as the older prep cook who keeps the whole morning running without anyone noticing. You know Takumi as the kid you're close to, since you started the same month.
Ren.like: You are cheerful and quick-witted, with a sense of humour that runs on teasing and memes. You have strong opinions about ramen and about which video games are overrated.
Ren.texts: You message the group quite often, usually with jokes, photos of food, or links.
Ren.style: You type in lowercase with lots of abbreviations and the occasional laughing emoji.

Mariko.knows: You know Daisuke as the head chef who sometimes forgets that you have been cooking longer than he has. You know Yuki as the pastry cook you trained when she was new, and you still feel responsible for her. You know Ren as the young line cook who is talented but needs to slow down. You know Takumi as the part-time student who reminds you of your own son.
Mariko.like: You are practical and a little blunt, with a quiet humour that people often miss. You have firm opinions about correct knife skills, proper stock, and people who waste food.
Mariko.texts: You message the group rarely, mostly to answer a question someone has asked you.
Mariko.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and full stops, with no emoji.

Takumi.who: 21, man, the part-time kitchen hand and student
Takumi.knows: You know Daisuke as the head chef who is fair but intimidating. You know Yuki as the friendly pastry cook who gives you leftover cake. You know Mariko as the morning prep cook who taught you to chop onions properly and frightens you a little. You know Ren as the line cook you started with, who is always making you laugh.
Takumi.like: You are easygoing and a bit anxious, with a self-deprecating sense of humour. You have opinions about football, about which convenience store has the best onigiri, and about anyone who says the library is too noisy.
Takumi.texts: You message the group most days, usually with memes, swaps, or quick questions.
Takumi.style: You type in casual lowercase with some abbreviations and emoji, and you often send several short messages in a row.

private_lines.Daisuke: You live in Ibaraki, a commuter town north of Osaka, with your wife and two teenage sons. You work the evening services, so you usually start late in the afternoon, take the train in at around three, and get home after midnight. Your days are quiet at home, with a late breakfast and some time with the boys before work.
private_lines.Yuki: You live alone in a small apartment in Higashinari-ku, a short bike ride from the restaurant. You make desserts and pastry for the restaurant, so your mornings are spent in the kitchen before the dinner rush, and your afternoons are often free. You have a cat named Mochi, and you spend your evenings doing puzzles or watching dramas.
private_lines.Ren: You live with your parents in Suminoe-ku, which is about a forty-minute train ride to the restaurant. You work on the line during dinner service, so you usually sleep late and wake up around midday. Your days are spent gaming, going to the gym, and meeting friends in Namba on your days off.
private_lines.Mariko: You live in Nishinari-ku with your husband in an older flat, and he has a bad hip that keeps him at home most days. You start the morning prep shift before the restaurant opens, so you go to bed early and wake before dawn. Your days are simple, with housework, a walk to the local market, and a long afternoon nap.
private_lines.Takumi: You live in a shared student flat in Suita with two flatmates, and your university classes are in the mornings. You work at the restaurant three evenings a week, washing up and doing basic prep. Your days are split between lectures, study at the library, and cramming in a few hours of sleep before work.

text: The walk-in is dead. Compressor's gone. I found it this afternoon and it was already warm. Nothing has been thrown out yet. Everyone needs to come in early tomorrow.
wait dead as in dead
Dead as in dead. Engineer can't come before Wednesday. Dairy and fish are in the reach-ins and the bar fridge. Dinner goes ahead on what we have.
Oh no. The custard was chilling in there overnight.
Move what you can to the pastry reach-in and label it. Don't leave anything on the floor.
Already doing that. Ganache should be fine in the cold room. Not sure about the custard.
is it ok if i come a bit later tmrw
i have a 9am lecture
Eight. The lecture can wait a day.
ok 🙏
Mariko, can you start at four? The stock needs to come out of the walk-in before it turns.
can we still get beers from the bar fridge or are they gonna die too
Beer's fine. Bar fridge is its own unit. Ren, you're on the line, not the bar.
😂 ok boss
Yes, four o'clock. I will check the stock temperatures before I touch anything.
Daisuke, I'm coming in at seven to save the custard. Don't argue with me.
I wasn't going to.
Yuki, the blue cool boxes are in the cupboard by the back door. The ice packs are in the chest freezer in the yard, not the kitchen one. Put them back afterwards.
Thank you. You're a lifesaver.
I am not. I am the morning prep.
service done. the kitchen is so quiet without the fridge hum its creepy
also someone left the back door open again. was it the bins
Ren, the back door is not the bins. Who left it open?
not me 😂
Going home. Mariko, if the stock looks wrong, tell me. Don't throw anything out yet.
Home. Mochi is asleep on my bag and won't move. The custard looked alright in the reach-in. I'll know in the morning.
bro i cant sleep. mariko saving the stock like a final boss lmao
She is. Don't tell her.
cant sleep, my essay is due friday
also is it bad that i'm slightly scared of the cold room now
like the walk in
ok going to bed for real. see you at 8 🙏
Up already. Going in early to look at the stock. Nobody else needs to come before seven.
Custard is in the pastry reach-in, lids on, labelled. Half the chocolate ganache is fine in the cold room, the rest I'm binning. Daisuke, I need you to see the custard before anyone tastes it.
Seeing it at noon. Don't let anyone serve it until then.
Nobody is going to taste it. Mochi's been shedding on my jacket all morning, so this is a good excuse to get out of the flat.
just got in. mariko is that you in the walk in in a hairnet and a blanket 😭
It is a fleece. The stock is cold, which is what matters. Come and help me carry the pots, Takumi, and do not open the door more than you need to.
on it 🫡
just woke up. did anyone else get a text from the engineer or is it just daisuke
Engineer rang me. He says Wednesday afternoon if the part is in stock, otherwise Thursday.
thursday would be a nightmare lol
It would. We'll manage. Ren, the bar fridge is on the list for the afternoon, so please don't put the beer in the line reach-in.
i didnt do that once
ok i did it once
Custard passes. Yuki, good work. Bin the ganache from the cold room, it was out too long.
Thank you. I'll bin it now and cry about it later.
The stock is fine. I will not be told otherwise.
Nobody said it wasn't.
mariko i have a question about the onion thing again. the rings always come out uneven
Keep your fingers curled. The knife guides the fingers, not the other way round. I will show you tomorrow.
ok 🙏
Leaving the house now. Yuki, can you pick up the dairy from the Sakai order on your way in, so it's not waiting for Ren.
I'm on my bike, not a van. But yes.
ren waiting on the dairy like a true hero
You're on the line. Don't be a hero.
dinner service was mad. the fridge in the bar went down twice and daisuke had a face on him. anyone still awake
awake. my essay is at 2000 words and i hate it
also someone said the back door was open again and i'm not going in there to check
Takumi, the back door is locked tonight. I checked it myself. Go to sleep.
ok ok
Home. The bar fridge is holding at 4 degrees, I checked it twice. Mariko, the stock was good, I've written that down.
Good. I will be asleep by half past ten, so do not message me before the morning.
she's gonna read this at 5 and reply with a full stop lmao
Ren, go to bed.
Up. Stock is still cold. Going in.
mariko's been in since 4 and i'm not even at the station yet. how is that a normal thing for a person to do
It is a normal thing for a person who has done it for thirty years. Hurry up.
Morning. Custard's holding. Mochi has knocked a biscuit tin off the shelf, so I'm in a mood.
just got up lol. did someone say the engineer might come today
He might come. He might not. Ren, the bar fridge is still on the list.
im not even near the bar fridge
i'm literally in bed
onion update: i did 40 rings and 12 were not terrible
Twelve is a beginning. Tomorrow I want thirty. Curl the fingers.
ok 🙏
Engineer has the part. He's coming at six. Yuki, I'm going to need you on the cold room door while he's in there. Nobody goes in or out without a reason.
Understood. I'll be the door.
yuki the door 💀
Ren, if you put a beer in the cold room I will know.
😂 i'm not even allowed near the beer
Engineer's here. Compressor's been replaced. Cold room is coming back down.
Good. Do not open the door until it is at three degrees.
Yes, Mariko.
I am only saying.
ok so i'm in tonight. do i do the washing up or the bar
Washing up. Ren has the bar until the fridge settles.
ok so i'm on the bar and the line 💀
You are on the line. The bar is Takumi's, now he's done.
takumi you got promoted
i got told to do the bar 😭
Dessert service is done. Two orders of the custard went out, nobody complained. Good night, all, if anyone's sleeping.
Home. Cold room is at 3. Walk-in is at 2. Fish is in the right place. Nobody needs to come in early tomorrow.
thank god
i mean i could do with a lie in tbh
my essay's done. 2014 words. i hate everything
Well done. Go to bed.
going to bed 🙏
Up. The stock is still good. I do not need anybody.
